So I'm Clara, and I'm from the Brazilian Information System.
I'm going to talk about our work in extending Darwin Core to represent
sociobiodiversity and traditional knowledge in Brazil.
First, I'm going to talk what is sociobiodiversity data.
So according to the Brazilian National Sociobiodiversity Plan from the Ministry of
Environment, Ministry of Social Development, and Ministry from Agrarian
Development, sociobiodiversity data is data describing the interrelationship
between biodiversity and sociocultural diversity, including biodiversity resources,
traditional practices, uses, and knowledge, reflecting the relationships between
biodiversity, indigenous people, traditional and local communities, and family
farmers. But where does this information come from?
So mainly, the most important source is the communities and territories themselves.
Indigenous people in local communities document their own biodiversity uses and
practices, and they are knowledge holders and data owners, and this information
should only be shared according to their consent and decisions in governance.
But we have other forms, other sources of this information.
We can find this information in scientific articles, biological collections, and
museums, often under the term occurrence remarks.
This information could be also found in works by naturalists,
the travelers and naturalists who visit Brazil between the 17th and 19th centuries,
documenting what they observe and learn, and also we can find this information in
market inventories or films.
And
so that's a-- oh, sorry. That's a great, interesting challenge.
We have different kinds of evidence,
different
information produced in different historical context, and it's always a challenge
to see who is the holder of this knowledge.
So for that reason, it was a SES project in 2024, together with
Brazil, Colombia, and Argentina, that we try to develop a data, the first
step, developing a data extension for documenting sociobiodiversity information.
So we had some webinars and in-person workshop that we end up with a
few terms. So terms like use-to, use-to description, use-form,
used-by holder. There was a few terms, one is controlled vocabularies that use
like used-to, organized by used-by type, source type, and other free text, like
used-by holder, use-form, use-to description.
All this information is stored in a GitHub repository.

companies that have some natural heritage genetic
